claim: The sample demo uses separate storage and does not replace real local work.
sandbox: Load real CSV files, enter /demo/, reload the sample, then return to the real workspace.

claim: The free workflow exports accepted sample rows as CSV and a reusable recipe as JSON.
where: Export rack, license panel, README, Terms
sandbox: Without a license, run the shipped demo and inspect both downloaded files; assert no license gate opens.

claim: Formula-like CSV values are neutralized in exports.
sandbox: Run the shipped demo and read its downloaded accepted CSV.

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: Visit /demo/, wait for the service worker, switch the browser offline, reload, and inspect the sample.

claim: Spreadsheet rows stay in the browser during normal and demo processing.
where: Landing assurance, network strip, README, Privacy
sandbox: Record requests while loading private normal files and running /demo/; assert all requests are same-origin and no row value appears in a URL.

claim: Cleanroom Plus costs $19 once, has no subscription, and includes unlimited on-device saved recipes.
where: Landing assurance, license panel, README, Terms
sandbox: Open the license panel from a fresh browser context and assert the price and included feature.

claim: Each CSV is limited to 10 MB and 50,000 data rows.
sandbox: Construct files beyond both boundaries and assert the parser rejects them with the advertised limits.

claim: Recipe JSON contains field names and rules, never spreadsheet rows.
sandbox: Export the mapped sample recipe, validate its schema, and assert no shipped spreadsheet value is present.

claim: Named transforms run, every output row is validated, rejects use target-field explanations, and an exported recipe can restore the mapping.
sandbox: Use the sample mapping, export it, alter it, import it, run inspection, and inspect transformed output plus target-field errors.

claim: With a license present, verification is the only third-party background request, includes no spreadsheet rows, and runs at most once daily.
sandbox: Mock a successful verification, load a private normal CSV, reload twice, and assert one token-only request to the Sociobot verification endpoint.

claim: Checkout and license verification use the Sociobot billing API; no payment provider is embedded.
sandbox: Open the license panel from a fresh demo context, inspect the checkout destination and loaded document, and assert no payment iframe, provider script, or provider request exists before a visitor selects checkout.
